name: Shipped features help
description: Help mode entries (help@1) for the Shipped features page.
author: Brett

entries.title: Shipped features
entries.text: Every feature of AmberX-AXF and axHub in one table, grouped by plugin / area. Tap a column header to sort, shift-click (or long-press and pick Then by) to sort by more columns, open Columns to show, hide and reorder them. Your view is remembered on this browser.

entries.title: Group by
entries.text: Groups the table by plugin / area, date shipped, build, PR or status, or shows no groups. Tap a group header to fold it; the counts show how many are live, behind a switch, partial, in progress or removed.

entries.title: Filters
entries.text: Search names, areas, builds, PR numbers (#397), commits and Brett's words. Chips narrow to a status, features with an API, or not deployed; pick plugins and a date range. Export CSV gives exactly the rows and columns you see.

entries.title: Sync and export
entries.text: Sync picks up new build events, merged PRs and deploys right away (it also runs by itself every couple of minutes). CSV and Markdown save the rows you see.

entries.title: Shipped features settings
entries.text: Install, uninstall or rebuild the Shipped features ledger (a SQLite file in the console's data folder).

entries.title: Columns
entries.text: Feature, plugin / area, description, status, build, PR, commit, date and time shipped, on main, deployed, how to reach it (deep link, REST, MCP, CLI, voice), settings key, help, version, who asked and tests. Tick to show, use the arrows to move a column. Reset brings back the default set.

entries.title: Shipped status
entries.text: Live: deployed. Behind a switch: shipped but off until a setting turns it on. Partial: on main, not deployed yet. In progress: still being built. Removed: taken out (kept here with its history).

entries.title: Row menu
entries.text: Right-click or long-press a row or a cell: open the feature, open its build, open its PR, copy a link to it, copy the cell's value, or mark it removed. The Build cell also offers the Build orchestrator's own items.

entries.title: Without the UI
entries.text: REST GET /api/plugins/shipped-features/table?view=<json> (kind=csv for a file) and POST /remove; the same as MCP tools (shipped-features table / remove), the CLI (node apps/console-web/plugins/shipped-features/ledger/ledger.mjs table --view '<json>'), the console action shipped-features.view (by=area;sort=shipped:desc;statuses=live) and voice: 'show shipped features not deployed, newest first'.

entries.title: Close the column picker
entries.text: Closes the column picker. Your column choices and order are already saved.

entries.title: Export CSV
entries.text: Downloads the rows and columns you see right now (filters, sort and hidden columns applied) as a CSV file.
entries.more: Also: GET /api/plugins/shipped-features/export?kind=csv, MCP shipped_features_export, axf shipped-features export.

entries.title: Help
entries.text: Opens this feature's help page in a new tab.

steps.say: This is every feature we've planned or shipped. New builds show up here as Planned the moment they're created.
Status shows where each one is: Planned, Queued, Building, In PR, Merged, Live. A tilde means the date was reconstructed from history.
Open a row for what you said, the PRs, and the Edits timeline: every later change to that feature, newest first.
